episodes.title: Ben Appel: I Escaped a Religious Cult — Then Found a Woke Cult at Columbia
episodes.description:
Ben Appel grew up in a religious cult where punishment for sin was an ever-present threat,  endured homophobic bullying public school in the 1990s, got sober after years of addiction — and then walked into Columbia University in 2017, where he was assigned a new label: cis white gay. His memoir, Cis White Gay, traces the line from fundamentalist shame to Ivy League dogma, and argues the two aren't as different as they look.

In this conversation, Ben and Jenny talk about spiritual abuse and its parallels to sexual abuse, the OCD/scrupulosity Ben developed as a child and which resurfaced at Columbia, why victimhood became social currency on campus, Foucault and the anti-capitalist roots of queer theory, how woke encourages people to fail, and what it cost him in friendships to say what he actually thought.
